title: Swords Expansion
description: need more vanilla style melee weapons?
body:
Are you ready to take your Minecraft world to the next level with incredible melee weapons?

Are you tired of mods that just don't measure up to your standards?

Look no further, because **Swords Expansion is here!** We're bringing you the best new melee weapons that perfectly complement the vanilla game!

![weapons in the inventory](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4478f6131cc372deeae00614314b2df5078fab6f.png)

All five of these awesome **weapons are available right from the start in the Wood category**! And get this, you can upgrade them to Netherite when you have the Diamond variant!

Each weapon has its own unique attack speed and damage, **so you can play however you like**
!
